candidate.answerReason: The distinct possible sums are 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11. There are five values, agreeing with choice B.

methods.label: List the sums systematically
methods.explanation:
Fix the chip from Bag A and add each possible chip from Bag B. Drawing \(1\) from Bag A gives sums \(3,5,7\); drawing \(3\) gives \(5,7,9\); drawing \(5\) gives \(7,9,11\).

This includes every pairing because all three choices from Bag A have been paired with all three choices from Bag B. Counting each sum value only once leaves
\[
3,5,7,9,11.
\]
There are \(5\) different values, choice \(\text{B}\).
